brief:
A mass attack by Israeli settlers on a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank has drawn renewed attention to an emerging cohort of ideologically driven radicals, according to Al-Monitor. The incident has placed focus on violent extremism among younger settlers in the territory.

The latest attack reflects a shift in settler activism toward more aggressive tactics and suggests a widening generational divide in settlement ideology and methods in the occupied territories.
dek: A mass attack by Israeli settlers on a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank has placed new focus on the emergence of a generation of radicals in the territory.
title: New generation of radical settlers escalates West Bank violence
